title: Augmented record configuration
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean input list, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and states in the finite set of size $n+1$. Given a Boolean table word, an optional Boolean summary, a Boolean word, integer table and state head positions, and an output prefix, define a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes and record states by setting its state to the initial record-machine state, retaining the input-head position of $c$, using the first $k$ work tapes and head positions of $c$, placing the table buffer on the next tape and the summary cells on the final tape with the specified head positions, and setting the output to the given prefix.
